# Redpanda Connect outputs

benthos-umh includes the outputs of Redpanda Connect v4.117.0. Use them in bridges and stand-alone flows next to the UMH outputs.

The pages below cover the outputs used most with UMH. Their configuration and field reference are generated from the version benthos-umh includes, so they list the fields your instance accepts.

| Output | Name in config | Description |
|---|---|---|
| [MQTT](mqtt.md) | `mqtt` | Pushes messages to an MQTT broker. |
| [HTTP Client](http_client.md) | `http_client` | Sends messages to an HTTP server. |
| [Kafka / Redpanda](redpanda.md) | `redpanda` | A Kafka output using the [Franz Kafka client library](https://github.com/twmb/franz-go). |
| [SQL Insert](sql_insert.md) | `sql_insert` | Inserts a row into an SQL database for each message. |
| [AMQP 0.9 (RabbitMQ)](amqp_0_9.md) | `amqp_0_9` | Sends messages to an AMQP (0.91) exchange. AMQP is a messaging protocol used by various message brokers, including RabbitMQ. |

## Other outputs

benthos-umh also includes these outputs. They have no page here yet. The links go to Redpanda's documentation, which describes the latest Redpanda Connect release, so a field can differ from version v4.117.0.

| Name in config | Description |
|---|---|
| [`amqp_1`](https://docs.redpanda.com/redpanda-connect/components/outputs/amqp_1/) | Sends messages to an AMQP (1.0) server. |
| [`arc`](https://docs.redpanda.com/redpanda-connect/components/outputs/arc/) | Writes data to an Arc database via the msgpack ingestion endpoint. |
| [`aws_dynamodb`](https://docs.redpanda.com/redpanda-connect/components/outputs/aws_dynamodb/) | Inserts items into a DynamoDB table. |
| [`aws_kinesis`](https://docs.redpanda.com/redpanda-connect/components/outputs/aws_kinesis/) | Sends messages to a Kinesis stream. |
| [`aws_kinesis_firehose`](https://docs.redpanda.com/redpanda-connect/components/outputs/aws_kinesis_firehose/) | Sends messages to a Kinesis Firehose delivery stream. |
| [`aws_s3`](https://docs.redpanda.com/redpanda-connect/components/outputs/aws_s3/) | Sends message parts as objects to an Amazon S3 bucket. Each object is uploaded with the path specified with the `path` field. |
| [`aws_sns`](https://docs.redpanda.com/redpanda-connect/components/outputs/aws_sns/) | Sends messages to an AWS SNS topic. |
| [`aws_sqs`](https://docs.redpanda.com/redpanda-connect/components/outputs/aws_sqs/) | Sends messages to an SQS queue. |
| [`azure_blob_storage`](https://docs.redpanda.com/redpanda-connect/components/outputs/azure_blob_storage/) | Sends message parts as objects to an Azure Blob Storage Account container. Each object is uploaded with the filename specified with the `container` field. |
| [`azure_cosmosdb`](https://docs.redpanda.com/redpanda-connect/components/outputs/azure_cosmosdb/) | Creates or updates messages as JSON documents in [Azure CosmosDB](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/cosmos-db/introduction). |
| [`azure_data_lake_gen2`](https://docs.redpanda.com/redpanda-connect/components/outputs/azure_data_lake_gen2/) | Sends message parts as files to an Azure Data Lake Gen2 filesystem. Each file is uploaded with the filename specified with the `path` field. |
| [`azure_queue_storage`](https://docs.redpanda.com/redpanda-connect/components/outputs/azure_queue_storage/) | Sends messages to an Azure Storage Queue. |
| [`azure_table_storage`](https://docs.redpanda.com/redpanda-connect/components/outputs/azure_table_storage/) | Stores messages in an Azure Table Storage table. |
| [`beanstalkd`](https://docs.redpanda.com/redpanda-connect/components/outputs/beanstalkd/) | Write messages to a Beanstalkd queue. |
| [`broker`](https://docs.redpanda.com/redpanda-connect/components/outputs/broker/) | Routes messages to multiple child outputs using a range of brokering [`patterns`](https://docs.redpanda.com/redpanda-connect/components/outputs/broker/#patterns). |
| [`cache`](https://docs.redpanda.com/redpanda-connect/components/outputs/cache/) | Stores each message in a [cache](https://docs.redpanda.com/redpanda-connect/components/caches/about/). |
| [`cassandra`](https://docs.redpanda.com/redpanda-connect/components/outputs/cassandra/) | Runs a query against a Cassandra database for each message in order to insert data. |
| [`couchbase`](https://docs.redpanda.com/redpanda-connect/components/outputs/couchbase/) | Performs operations against Couchbase for each message, allowing you to store or delete data. |
| [`cyborgdb`](https://docs.redpanda.com/redpanda-connect/components/outputs/cyborgdb/) | Inserts items into a CyborgDB encrypted vector index. |
| [`cypher`](https://docs.redpanda.com/redpanda-connect/components/outputs/cypher/) | Writes batches of messages to any database that speaks the Bolt protocol, such as Neo4j or Memgraph, using operations written in the Cypher query language. |
| [`discord`](https://docs.redpanda.com/redpanda-connect/components/outputs/discord/) | Writes messages to a Discord channel. |
| [`doris_stream_load`](https://docs.redpanda.com/redpanda-connect/components/outputs/doris_stream_load/) (beta) | Writes batches of messages into Apache Doris using Stream Load. |
| [`drop`](https://docs.redpanda.com/redpanda-connect/components/outputs/drop/) | Drops all messages. |
| [`drop_on`](https://docs.redpanda.com/redpanda-connect/components/outputs/drop_on/) | Attempts to write messages to a child output and if the write fails for one of a list of configurable reasons the message is dropped (acked) instead of being reattempted (or nacked). |
| [`dynamic`](https://docs.redpanda.com/redpanda-connect/components/outputs/dynamic/) | A special broker type where the outputs are identified by unique labels and can be created, changed and removed during runtime via a REST API, which is disabled by default and enabled with the `bind_http` field. |
| [`elasticsearch_v8`](https://docs.redpanda.com/redpanda-connect/components/outputs/elasticsearch_v8/) | Publishes messages into an Elasticsearch index. If the index does not exist then it is created with a dynamic mapping. |
| [`elasticsearch_v9`](https://docs.redpanda.com/redpanda-connect/components/outputs/elasticsearch_v9/) | Publishes messages into an Elasticsearch index. If the index does not exist then it is created with a dynamic mapping. |
| [`fallback`](https://docs.redpanda.com/redpanda-connect/components/outputs/fallback/) | Attempts to send each message to a child output, starting from the first output on the list. If an output attempt fails then the next output in the list is attempted, and so on. |
| [`file`](https://docs.redpanda.com/redpanda-connect/components/outputs/file/) | Writes messages to files on disk based on a chosen codec. |
| [`gcp_bigquery`](https://docs.redpanda.com/redpanda-connect/components/outputs/gcp_bigquery/) | Sends messages as new rows to a Google Cloud BigQuery table. |
| [`gcp_cloud_storage`](https://docs.redpanda.com/redpanda-connect/components/outputs/gcp_cloud_storage/) | Sends message parts as objects to a Google Cloud Storage bucket. Each object is uploaded with the path specified with the `path` field. |
| [`gcp_pubsub`](https://docs.redpanda.com/redpanda-connect/components/outputs/gcp_pubsub/) | Sends messages to a GCP Cloud Pub/Sub topic. [Metadata](https://docs.redpanda.com/redpanda-connect/configuration/metadata/) from messages are sent as attributes. |
| [`hdfs`](https://docs.redpanda.com/redpanda-connect/components/outputs/hdfs/) | Sends message parts as files to a HDFS directory. |
| [`http_server`](https://docs.redpanda.com/redpanda-connect/components/outputs/http_server/) | Sets up an HTTP server that will send messages over HTTP(S) GET requests. HTTP 2.0 is supported when using TLS, which is enabled when key and cert files are specified. |
| [`inproc`](https://docs.redpanda.com/redpanda-connect/components/outputs/inproc/) | Sends data directly to inputs in the same process by connecting to a unique ID, to link isolated streams when running in streams mode. |
| [`mongodb`](https://docs.redpanda.com/redpanda-connect/components/outputs/mongodb/) | Inserts items into a MongoDB collection. |
| [`nanomsg`](https://docs.redpanda.com/redpanda-connect/components/outputs/nanomsg/) | Send messages over a Nanomsg socket. |
| [`nats`](https://docs.redpanda.com/redpanda-connect/components/outputs/nats/) | Publishes to a NATS subject. |
| [`nats_jetstream`](https://docs.redpanda.com/redpanda-connect/components/outputs/nats_jetstream/) | Writes messages to a NATS JetStream subject. |
| [`nats_kv`](https://docs.redpanda.com/redpanda-connect/components/outputs/nats_kv/) | Puts messages in a NATS key-value bucket. |
| [`nats_stream`](https://docs.redpanda.com/redpanda-connect/components/outputs/nats_stream/) | Publishes to a NATS Stream subject. |
| [`nsq`](https://docs.redpanda.com/redpanda-connect/components/outputs/nsq/) | Publish to an NSQ topic. |
| [`ockam_kafka`](https://docs.redpanda.com/redpanda-connect/components/outputs/ockam_kafka/) | Uses Ockam to encrypt and write end-to-end encrypted messages to a Kafka topic. |
| [`opensearch`](https://docs.redpanda.com/redpanda-connect/components/outputs/opensearch/) | Publishes messages into an Elasticsearch index. If the index does not exist then it is created with a dynamic mapping. |
| [`otlp_grpc`](https://docs.redpanda.com/redpanda-connect/components/outputs/otlp_grpc/) | Send OpenTelemetry traces, logs, and metrics via OTLP/gRPC protocol. |
| [`otlp_http`](https://docs.redpanda.com/redpanda-connect/components/outputs/otlp_http/) | Send OpenTelemetry traces, logs, and metrics via OTLP/HTTP protocol. |
| [`pinecone`](https://docs.redpanda.com/redpanda-connect/components/outputs/pinecone/) | Inserts items into a Pinecone index. |
| [`pulsar`](https://docs.redpanda.com/redpanda-connect/components/outputs/pulsar/) | Write messages to an Apache Pulsar server. |
| [`pusher`](https://docs.redpanda.com/redpanda-connect/components/outputs/pusher/) | Publishes messages to the [Pusher](https://pusher.com) API. |
| [`qdrant`](https://docs.redpanda.com/redpanda-connect/components/outputs/qdrant/) | Adds items to a [Qdrant](https://qdrant.tech/) collection. |
| [`questdb`](https://docs.redpanda.com/redpanda-connect/components/outputs/questdb/) | Pushes messages to a QuestDB table. |
| [`redis_hash`](https://docs.redpanda.com/redpanda-connect/components/outputs/redis_hash/) | Sets Redis hash objects using the HSET command. |
| [`redis_list`](https://docs.redpanda.com/redpanda-connect/components/outputs/redis_list/) | Pushes messages onto the end of a Redis list (which is created if it doesn't already exist) using the RPUSH command. |
| [`redis_pubsub`](https://docs.redpanda.com/redpanda-connect/components/outputs/redis_pubsub/) | Publishes messages through the Redis PubSub model. It is not possible to guarantee that messages have been received. |
| [`redis_streams`](https://docs.redpanda.com/redpanda-connect/components/outputs/redis_streams/) | Pushes messages to a Redis (v5.0+) Stream (which is created if it doesn't already exist) using the XADD command. |
| [`redpanda_migrator`](https://docs.redpanda.com/redpanda-connect/components/outputs/redpanda_migrator/) | Migrates topics, records, schemas, consumer group offsets, and topic ACLs from a source Kafka or Redpanda cluster to a destination cluster. |
| [`reject`](https://docs.redpanda.com/redpanda-connect/components/outputs/reject/) | Rejects all messages, treating them as though the output destination failed to publish them. |
| [`reject_errored`](https://docs.redpanda.com/redpanda-connect/components/outputs/reject_errored/) | Rejects messages that have failed their processing steps, resulting in nack behavior at the input level, otherwise sends them to a child output. |
| [`resource`](https://docs.redpanda.com/redpanda-connect/components/outputs/resource/) | Resource is an output type that channels messages to a resource output, identified by its name. |
| [`retry`](https://docs.redpanda.com/redpanda-connect/components/outputs/retry/) | Attempts to write messages to a child output and if the write fails for any reason the message is retried either until success or, if the retries or max elapsed time fields are non-zero, either is reached. |
| [`schema_registry`](https://docs.redpanda.com/redpanda-connect/components/outputs/schema_registry/) | Publishes schemas to a schema registry. |
| [`sftp`](https://docs.redpanda.com/redpanda-connect/components/outputs/sftp/) | Writes files to an SFTP server. |
| [`socket`](https://docs.redpanda.com/redpanda-connect/components/outputs/socket/) | Connects to a (tcp/udp/unix) server and sends a continuous stream of data, dividing messages according to the specified codec. |
| [`sql_raw`](https://docs.redpanda.com/redpanda-connect/components/outputs/sql_raw/) | Executes an arbitrary SQL query for each message. |

| [`switch`](https://docs.redpanda.com/redpanda-connect/components/outputs/switch/) | The switch output type allows you to route messages to different outputs based on their contents. |
| [`sync_response`](https://docs.redpanda.com/redpanda-connect/components/outputs/sync_response/) | Returns the final message payload back to the input origin of the message, where it is dealt with according to that specific input type. |
| [`timeplus`](https://docs.redpanda.com/redpanda-connect/components/outputs/timeplus/) | Sends message to a Timeplus Enterprise stream via ingest endpoint |
| [`websocket`](https://docs.redpanda.com/redpanda-connect/components/outputs/websocket/) | Sends messages to an HTTP server via a websocket connection. |
